scoring: Original native RoboDojo checker, success and progress, no model-text scoring

cost_accounting.model: Native CLI reported cumulative turn usage, including cached input. Unknown on missing terminal reports.
cost_accounting.local: Per-run wait/getrusage plus 5-second GPU board power/memory/utilization and process RSS sampling.
cost_accounting.billing: Existing login: actual per-experiment money charge unavailable; do not equate API token prices to subscription billing.
cost_accounting.orchestrator: Goal meter recorded separately; no assumption that summing it with actor usage equals a provider invoice.

limitations: Author official 50 episodes use an unpublished hidden seed; public suite is a separate published comparison.
Private container, exact CLI version and model snapshot unavailable.
checkpoint_policy: One episode per case, no optimizer, no outcome-dependent retries or prompt/tool changes. Full corrected 20-case protocol frozen before launch.

calibration_correction.problem: SDK get_intrinsics_matrix uses head vertical USD aperture not used by square-pixel RTX projection.

superseded_policy: Preserve all raw evidence, scores and costs, including the successful case. Do not pool with corrected primary evaluation.
